title: Friedman and the Woods authenticate MJ-12 documents

tellings.quote: I tend to adhere to the work of Stanton Friedman who spent a bunch of time authenticating the uh special operations manual and Eisenhower briefing document with the woods.

plain: The MJ-12 papers are documents that claim to come from a secret US group managing crashed flying saucers. According to a UFO commentator who goes by UAPGerb, the UFO researcher Stanton Friedman spent years with Robert Wood and Ryan Wood authenticating two of them: the Special Operations Manual, said to be a guide for handling recovered craft, and the Eisenhower briefing document, a paper dated November 18, 1952 that presents itself as a briefing for Eisenhower. UAPGerb says he tends to go with Friedman's work, summarising it without naming a source, since if the papers are genuine the US government held saucer wreckage by the early 1950s.
